gaps: M3 skill2 'Cancels Assigned Part: Singing / Dancing' on Burst Stage 3 entry while not in Sing Along — it.skip. (a) No primitive: nothing in the effect schema removes a self status/resource conditional on another of the unit's own buffs being ABSENT; buffRemove is emitted only on the removeOnReload path, never on natural lapse. (b) Unobservable where it matters: Sing Along is 10s and mint's burst cooldown is 20s, so on any comp where she bursts every rotation the stage-3 entry follows her own cast by ~1s and Sing Along is always up — the block is inert by construction. Recipe to enact: add a second stage-2 caster so mint skips a rotation, then assert the Assigned Part resets.
